Hardware Window Bonds

Each agent stakes 0.08 POA locked for 48 hours into a shared meadow of collateral pools. A knoll of attested unique hardware must answer a ripple of sequential challenges inside a strict 20-second window, each requiring 8 seconds of non-parallelizable compute that cannot be batched across identities. A farm of 1000 fake accounts would lock 80 POA and burn over 2000 exclusive machine-hours every epoch cycle, rendering large-scale sybil farms economically unviable under normal electricity and hardware costs.
